verdict.rationale: ADK's first-party docs state that an ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools from external MCP servers, and the GitHub README lists MCP tools as part of its tool ecosystem, so the product itself delivers the core of this story. The evidence is limited to overview-level statements. missing for 10: documented connection details (transports such as stdio/SSE/HTTP, configuration or code examples for attaching an MCP server, tool filtering/auth), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: An ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools provided by external MCP servers.
Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities
